title: Yesterday I saw one of the locations I have visted many times in mall world.
content: Yesterday I saw one of the places I’ve seen in my dreams many times in real life. There is a new Casino that opened up where I live, I visited friends there yesterday for the first time since it opened (opened December 2024 ) and when I waked in and walked past the bar I was frozen in shock…. It looks beyond similar / almost identical to the bar I see in my dreams . Have seen for years before this place was even a concept or built … let alone I’ve never seen this before besides my dreams…. From the color… to the lights hanging down from the bar… the only difference is the bar I see in my dreams is apart of a restaurant underground underneath the ocean pier waterpark . The bar / restraint Is in the same building . Connected . The bar I see in real life that is basically identical to what I see in my dreams is just in the middle of the desert connected to a casino… the first few images I will show is my AI interpretation of the bar / restaurant I have been dreaming of for 7 or more years the last few photos are the real life casino bar that just opened up. My AI photos and my dreams never had a casino connected to this place… I don’t even know how to process my emotions after seeing this…. I am in disbelief.. is anyone else all of a sudden seeing things they have seen almost exclusively in there dreams pop up out of no where especially as new construction and new places that have never even existed before…. I’m shaking writing this and have been in a constant anxiety state since I saw this …
